explainer_body: Everything runs on your device, privately, at no cost. That never changes. Pro is optional: bigger, faster models in the cloud, for when your device can't keep up.
pro_point_fast: Fast on any phone or laptop
pro_point_cloud: Messages are processed by Gratis in the cloud
pro_point_switch: Switch back to on-device any time
settings_promise_body: On-device chat has no limits, no account and no ads. Pro is an optional add-on for devices that can't run advanced models.
show_models_hint: List cloud models in the model menu
wizard_title: Want something bigger than this device can run?
wizard_body: Gratis Pro runs advanced models in the cloud. Optional: the free on-device model is yours either way.
signed_in_toast: Signed in. Pro models are in the model menu.
error_no_plan: Your Gratis account has no Pro plan yet. Pick one at account.gratis-ai.com, or keep chatting on-device for free.
error_not_in_plan: This model isn't in your Pro plan. Try Pro Fast, or an on-device model.
error_allowance_used: You've used this week's Pro allowance. On-device models keep working for free.
error_busy: Too many Pro replies at once. Wait a moment and try again.
error_capacity: Gratis Pro is busy right now. Try again later, or switch to an on-device model.
